summary: End-to-end verification of Salt Spray 'Kartu Pengamatan' (1 photo = 4 plates) feature. BACKEND pytest 5/5 (/app/backend/tests/test_salt_observations.py): validation 400s (missing photo_path, plates!=4, empty code), GET list returns only new-format cards with 4 plates & 100 grid_boxes each, full detect roundtrip (POST /salt-spray/observations/detect/start -> poll /detect/jobs/{id} ~2min, real Gemini) returned status=done + detection='ai' + 4 plates with bbox/crop_path/grid_boxes[100]/ai_grid_boxes[100]/rusted_box_count/grade/confidence/summary, grade matched count buckets (A=0, B=1-10, C=11-25, D=26-50, E=51+), POST creates card with edited=False (grid==ai), PUT toggles one box -> rusted_box_count+1 & edited=True & grade recomputed, DELETE soft-removes and GET returns 404 and card is excluded from list. Elapsed 118s with 1 AI call. FRONTEND /salt-spray/observations: seeded card (seq 1, '24 Jam', codes 251360/251361/251362/251363) renders photo with 4 colored bbox labels, 4 plate cards with 100-cell grids, counts/grades (48/D, 8/B, 50/D, 11/C), summary + confidence. Toggling box-50 decremented count 48->47 and showed 'Dikoreksi inspector · AI: N' with reset button; reset restored 47->48. KARTU BARU -> draft; BATAL cancels; uploading fixture /app/tests/fixtures/saltspray_four_plates.jpg triggered 'obs-detect-stage' and in ~2min produced 4 AI-detected plates (obs-detection-mode='AI: 4 PLAT TERDETEKSI'); saving with empty codes showed 'Isi kode Sample' toast; filling codes ZZTEST_1..4 + SIMPAN KARTU replaced draft with saved card; after reload the codes persisted; cleaned up with DELETE 200. Export PDF uses iframe (not popup) and did not crash; zero console errors throughout. AI budget consumed this run: 2 Gemini jobs (1 backend pytest + 1 frontend upload) = 8 panel grading calls + 2 detection calls.
